title: dropna
code:
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, np.nan, 3], "b": [4, 5, np.nan]})
print(len(df.dropna()))
codeHtml: import numpy as np import pandas as pd df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, np.nan, 3], "b": [4, 5, np.nan]}) print(len(df.dropna()))
explain: dropna() toglie ogni riga con almeno un valore mancante: resta solo la prima.
